summary: The proposed patch introduces a conditional encoding mechanism based on the hashing algorithm, which may address the issue but lacks comprehensive testing and documentation.

issues.description: The patch does not include any new tests to verify the behavior of the conditional encoding logic.
There is no update to the documentation explaining the new conditional encoding mechanism and its implications.
The approach of using legacy encoding when DEFAULT_HASHING_ALGORITHM is 'sha1' is considered hacky and may introduce fragility.
